description: The pie chart represents the distribution of various categories related to instruction following in language models, divided into nine slices. The chart includes three inner slices labeled "Context Tracking" (dark blue, approximately 15%), "Context Retrieving" (teal, approximately 25%), and "Contradiction Resolution" (red, approximately 20%). The outer ring is divided into six slices: "Triggering" (blue, 100), "Recursive Reasoning" (blue, 110), "Dynamic Environment" (dark blue, 100), "Memorization" (teal, 100), "Dynamic Instruction" (teal, 100), and "Multitasking" (teal, 160), with the remaining two slices being "Personalization" (red, 100) and "Privacy Protection" (red, 111). The chart does not include a legend, but numerical labels are provided outside the chart for each outer slice. The inner slices are visually emphasized by being positioned inside the chart and having labels within them. The outer slices appear to be ordered by their numerical labels, which range from 100 to 160.
